answer: The first-line treatment for dry eye is artificial tears and environmental modifications, such as reducing screen time and using a humidifier [National Eye Institute, 2022]. Prescription anti-inflammatory drops or punctal plugs are considered if the condition does not improve with lubrication alone.

results.content: Dry eye disease is managed first-line with artificial tears and environmental modification (reducing screen time, using humidifiers). Prescription anti-inflammatory drops or punctal plugs are considered for moderate to severe cases unresponsive to lubrication alone.
results.source: National Eye Institute Patient Guide: Dry Eye

results.content: Annual dilated eye exams are recommended for all patients with diabetes to screen for diabetic retinopathy, since early stages are often asymptomatic. Anti-VEGF injections are first-line treatment for diabetic macular edema and proliferative disease.
results.source: National Eye Institute Patient Guide: Diabetic Retinopathy
